specs.Additional Features: Drop Proof, Temperature Proof, Water Proof, X Ray Proof

features: ✅ HIGH TRANSPORT SPEED: Transfer read speed up to 95MB/s, write speed 20MB/s (based on internal testing; performance may be lower depending on host device, interface, usage conditions and other factors).
✅ Widely Application: Micro SD card is high compatibility for different types of devices, including smartphones, tablets, drones, android tablets, tablet pcs, or full HD camcorders.
✅ BUILT TO LAST RELIABILITY: Made and tested to work in extreme conditions; waterproof, temperature-resistant, shock and X-ray resistant.
✅ Class 10: Take photos and record videos in Full HD and 4K resolution.
✅ Operating temperature: -15 to 70 °C, ideal for most situations.
description: Imou S1 microSD Memory Card is one of the high-speed card series. The speed grade can reach Class 10, U3 and V30, which can meet the daily use of digital cameras, mobile phones, laptops, game consoles, etc., allowing you to read and write data such as photos, audio, video and other data, and enjoy the speed experience.
